diagnostics.name: Szekelyhidi_Proposition_5_printed_cone_construction
diagnostics.check: The shifted level section lies in B10 and v belongs to the printed A_delta. For every direction in the printed C_v, sum(w)=0 because f(v+t*w)=f(v)=4. Hence C_v cannot contain the positive orthant, contrary to the printed construction. The cited quantitative alternative itself is not refuted.

diagnostics.name: Dong_Zhang_square_free_multi_indices
diagnostics.check: For n=3,k=2, sigma2>0 on the positive orthant, but the second derivative in a repeated coordinate is identically zero. The displayed strict positivity for every multi-index of order at most k is literally false; elementary symmetric polynomials require square-free indices for this characterization.

diagnostics.name: Dong_Zhang_Lemma_3_1_missing_conjugates
diagnostics.source: 2603.19045v1, actual page 10, equation (3.1); contrast (3.2) on page 11
diagnostics.check: The literal bilinear-square formula fails. The same computation holds for every R>=1 with lambda=(R,1/R,0), so the level remains 1 and R can be arbitrarily large. Equation (3.2) correctly uses conjugates and modulus squares; this check does not refute that sesquilinear inequality or the Guo--Song chain-rule conversion.

diagnostics.name: Dong_Zhang_final_negative_remainder
diagnostics.check: The text explicitly chooses the last remainder in (3.38) negative and then claims the bound without that remainder. A lower bound B minus a positive quantity does not imply the lower bound B. This diagnoses the printed inference; it does not construct eigenvalues violating Lemma 3.2, certify a complete repair, or refute Guo--Song Theorem 1.3 under its separately imposed refined-concavity hypothesis.

cleared_objections.name: Fixed_auxiliary_density_L2_control
cleared_objections.check: Fixing M before epsilon0 keeps the auxiliary density average 1, its baseline at least 1/2, and its L2 bound at most 4. A growing spike with an uncontrolled constant is not the argument in Guo--Song Proposition 2.8.

cleared_objections.name: No_fixed_det_DF_required
cleared_objections.check: The harmonic-mean operator in Guo--Song Remark 3.3 has derivative determinant tending to zero. The direct method uses quantitative subsolution geometry rather than a universal derivative-determinant lower bound.

cleared_objections.name: No_comparison_gradient_circularity
